Decks/Precon/Precon_EPPFDN_UB_desc_updat: Bide your time with removal spells and card filtering, then extract huge value from your well-stocked graveyard!
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPPFDN_UR_desc_updat: Throw caution to the wind by flinging spells at the opponent and overwhelming them with your wizarding ways!
Decks/Precon/Precon_July_B: As a black mage, every advantage comes at a cost. Sacrifice whatever is necessary to control the forces of death and darkness.
Decks/Precon/Precon_July_Desc_BG: Utilize creatures that explore through the deck to get an advantage on your opponent.
Decks/Precon/Precon_July_Desc_BR: Plunder and pillage your enemies with the cunning maneuvers of pirates! Make them walk the plank.
Decks/Precon/Precon_July_Desc_GU: Sneak past your foe's defenses and manipulate the battlefield to your benefit with the slick Merfolk of Ixalan.
Decks/Precon/Precon_July_Desc_GW: Build up a powerful army and overrun the battlefield. Find glory and strength in numbers.
Decks/Precon/Precon_July_Desc_RG: Useful early on, even stronger later. Utilize the flexibility of kicker spells to get more might for your mana.
Decks/Precon/Precon_July_Desc_RW: Combine powerful weapons and enchantments with your creatures to overpower your foes.
Decks/Precon/Precon_July_Desc_UB: Seize control of the battlefield and once it's yours, summon powerful creatures to finish off your enemies.
Decks/Precon/Precon_July_Desc_UR: Cast powerful spells to manipulate the game. Utilize your wizards to improve your magic even further.
Decks/Precon/Precon_July_Desc_WB: Outlive your opponent by using your opponent's lifeforce to heal your wounds. Your life means their death.
Decks/Precon/Precon_July_Desc_WU: Unlock the hidden power of artifacts using White and Blue magic. Craft awesome combos to take down the opposition.
Decks/Precon/Precon_July_G: As a green mage, the natural world is at your command. The power of life itself fuels your magic.
Decks/Precon/Precon_July_R: As a red mage, you revel in the chaos of battle. Fire is your weapon and your inspiration.
Decks/Precon/Precon_July_U: As a blue mage, you control the battlefield through illusion. Always think three steps ahead of your foe.
Decks/Precon/Precon_July_W: As a white mage, you command disciplined armies. Enforce order to overwhelm your enemies.
Decks/Precon/Precon_NPE_GRN_WU_Desc_2: Soar over your opponent's defense while protecting your front-line with tactical spells.
